  \caption{Computational cost of one full run per variant on the reference stream (KNAD Active Wiretap, seed A). All 12 runs in the table were executed with exclusive use of the machine, on device /GPU:0. Phases are the DBSCAN feature map, the autoencoder training pass and the streaming execution; the execution throughput is measured as implemented, with the per-row Python loop included, at the batch size of the implementation, and is therefore an amortised throughput and not a per-packet decision cost: the batch-1 latency of one window, which is what an operator waits for, is reported separately in Section~6.6 of the manuscript. Parameters are the sum of \texttt{count\_params} over the ensemble autoencoders; the two numpy variants (\texttt{original} and \texttt{stat}) do not publish that attribute and are shown as \texttt{--} here, with their explicit weight counts given in Table~9 of the manuscript. The last column is the wall time of the whole post-processing stage on CPU, which also computes every pre-specified sensitivity and is therefore an upper bound on the cost of the detectors, the fusion and the threshold alone. This table contains no predictive-performance figure.}
